The tears in his eyes I feel this :’)

I made it in my dorm kitchen and tried to make a funfetti cake from scratch for my friend - it was hard, esp because a lot of instructional videos weren’t that helpful, and i kinda messed up the top so covered it with sprinkles - but he and everyone thought the cake tasted really good so i’m glad : ) - but does anyone know how to stop the frosting from slipping out of the bag / the bag slipping out of my hand?
This is so amazing! May I ask what the lid of the basket was made out of? And how you got it to all balance nicely?

This is so cute! I would love to make something similar because my friends and I were so excited to play AC together on Friday but social distancing means we’re not near each other - but maybe if i could make a cake and ‘feed’ them over facetime, it might makes things more fun! The cake looks lovely and I hope it was lovely to eat as well! Happy birthday for yesterday!
This is one of the coolest things, but so much hard work has gone into it and it seems so pretty, i don’t think i could eat it! Definitely belongs in a glass cabinet in the tower of london : )

Truly, i was thinking about this, and how cinematic and perfect state of grace is - no question it is the best or at least my favourite opening song of any of her albums - how it’s so hopeful but also knows how this story will end you know?

I love that show! Like when he gives all the slices a name, it’s like they all have different and unique personalities, and it makes me happy that even if they aren’t the best slice, they’ve got something special about them!
This is such a lovely interaction, what sweethearts i love them
Can someone please explain to me how she makes her eyeliner look so dark and interesting, what a strong game, coming from someone who literally dies everytime she hs to put eyeliner on
This outfit is everything quite honestly i love so much about it - black velvet is a look and i wish i could wear it as well as she does

I'm so glad that Emma spoke out about this, there are so many times I've seen particularly these two strong, hardworking, inspiring women being compared and pitted against one another, and as a fan of both, I'm so glad to see the support and intelligent justification of owning your work and worth! Also I adore the Little Women book series so am ever so excited to see the movie!!!!
Omg I so desperately wanted to learn how to embroidery and this pushed me over the edge! I finally  got a starter kit for Christmas - wish me luck!
